name: Alminster of Azeroth
tagline: Stay current on WoW: Forever, the news, and the markets.
supportLine: Every bit of support helps keep the stream going, morning after morning.
about: Alminster has played World of Warcraft since the original launch in 2004, from Classic to Hardcore to PvP.
In World of Warcraft: Forever, the plan is an Alliance main on the PvP ruleset, with a Horde character on the RP ruleset later.
While he plays, he talks stocks and current events as side commentary. Options trading is a personal interest.
Streams usually start early in the morning, Pacific Time, and often run for hours. There is no fixed schedule.

games.intro: More than two decades in Azeroth, and the road keeps going.
